templates.name: Meridian Bank — Card Fraud Investigation
templates.description: Card fraud investigation demo: a VP of Fraud Operations traces a $2.4M weekly fraud spike to compromised POS terminals at QuickMart, using dashboards, Genie analytics, and a Knowledge Assistant to surface the merchant security audit.

templates.name: Lakeside Health System — Readmission Investigation
templates.description: Hospital readmission investigation demo: a Chief Medical Officer traces an 18% readmission rate (double the CMS target) to heart failure patients with a discharge protocol gap, using dashboards, Genie analytics, and a Knowledge Assistant.

templates.name: FreshMart Grocery — Stockout Investigation
templates.description: Retail stockout investigation demo: a VP of Supply Chain traces $4.2M in lost sales to dairy stockouts at 23 stores caused by a demand forecast miss during a stadium concert, using dashboards, Genie, and a Knowledge Assistant.

templates.name: Precision Motors — Equipment Failure Investigation
templates.description: Manufacturing defect investigation demo: a VP of Manufacturing traces an 8.5% defect rate (3x target) to ignored vibration warnings on CNC machines at the Detroit plant, using dashboards, Genie analytics, and a Knowledge Assistant.

templates.name: StreamVue Media — Subscriber Churn Investigation
templates.description: Subscriber churn investigation demo: a VP of Retention traces 4.8% monthly churn (double normal) to an offline playback bug affecting mobile-first users, using dashboards, Genie analytics, and a Knowledge Assistant.

templates.name: Pacific Grid Utilities — Transformer Failure Investigation
templates.description: Utility outage investigation demo: a VP of Grid Operations traces 47 unplanned outages (3x normal) to a cooling system defect in a batch of distribution transformers, using dashboards, Genie analytics, and a Knowledge Assistant.

templates.name: SkyWest Airlines — Delay Investigation
templates.description: Airline delay investigation demo: a VP of Operations traces on-time performance dropping to 62% to an APU software bug affecting departure turnarounds, using dashboards, Genie analytics, and a Knowledge Assistant.
